name: Erlebnispark Hög Serfaus
kurzbeschreibung: Hög Adventure Park in Serfaus at 1,820 m: idyllic Högsee lake with boats, Family Coaster Schneisenfeger, lumberjack area, and family recreation.
beschreibung:
Overview

The expansive Hög Adventure Park is situated on a sunny high plateau at 1,820 meters above sea level, surrounding the picturesque Högsee lake in the Tyrolean municipality of Serfaus in the Landeck district. As a prominent component of the family-friendly ski dimension Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis, the amusement park combines alpine mountain scenery with innovative nature and fun sports attractions. Everything revolves around the themes of alpine pasture and forestry, as well as alpine water experiences, set against the impressive mountain backdrop of the Samnaun Group and the Ötztal Alps, around the crystal-clear, 14-meter-deep reservoir and swimming lake.

Route & Requirements

The heart of the park is the idyllic Högsee lake: an artificially created mountain lake with excellent water quality, which invites swimming in summer with shallow water areas and bathing jetties. A boat rental offers pedal boats, rowing boats, and Stand-Up Paddles (SUP) for excursions on the water. For nature enthusiasts and children, the interactive Lumberjack Area has been created: here, young and old explorers can experience old lumberjack crafts at lovingly designed adventure stations, climb through a wooden obstacle course, explore the secret of tree rings on a giant tree trunk, and play in a wooden show dairy.

Visit & Arrival

Hög Adventure Park is open daily during the summer season from mid-June to mid-October, from 08:30 to 17:00. Admission to Hög Adventure Park, the sunbathing lawns, and the lumberjack playground is free. Separate fees apply for the use of the cable car and the Family Coaster Schneisenfeger. Schneisenfeger single ride (as of season 2025/2026): Adults approx. €9.50, children (birth years 2011–2018) approx. €6.50. Holders of the regional Super. Sommer. Card. use the cable cars in Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis free of charge and unlimited. Arrival by cable car: Take the Alpkopfbahn from the Serfaus valley station directly to the Hög middle station (only about 6 minutes travel time). Arrival by car: Via the B180 (Reschenstraße) to Ried im Oberinntal, then continue on the state road up to Serfaus to the large parking lots at the valley entrance (Serfaus is traffic-calmed, take the U-Bahn Dorfbahn Serfaus to the cable car valley station).

Tips

The entire area around Högsee, the lake restaurant, and the paths in the lumberjack park are barrier-free and easily accessible with strollers and wheelchairs. Stop at the Seealm Hög directly on the shore and enjoy Tyrolean pike-perch fillet, wood-fired pizza, or Kaiserschmarrn on the large sun terrace with a view over the water, ensuring eventful and absolutely unforgettable holidays for the whole family in the sun-drenched Tyrolean mountains of the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis region.
